title: Number of Smooth Descent Periods of a Stock
goal: Count periods where each price is exactly one lower than the previous price.
strategy: The length of the current smooth-descent suffix equals the number of valid periods ending today. Extend it on a difference of exactly one; otherwise restart at one.
